## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour I changed, and `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes (`pnpm format` fixes formatting)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] If I changed a component in `packages/lesson/src/components`: I ran `pnpm docs:components` and committed `docs/en/components.md`
- [ ] If I changed the player or the studio: screenshots or a short recording are below
- [ ] If the change shows text or layout: I checked it in **Arabic (right to left)** as well as French or English
- [ ] If I added UI strings: they exist in every catalog (`ar`, `fr`, `en`)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`) when users will notice the change
- [ ] No API keys, private PDFs, page images or student data in the diff
